context.brief: untracked/T386-cycle-resolution-adr.md (kanban set=M; landmark L2 proven 4x4 values). Deliver an ADR (docs/decisions/0021-cycle-resolution-by-superko.md) evaluating the operator's proposal: 'Pass 1: enumerate positions, legality, link successors. Pass 2: retrograde from terminal. Pass 3: retrograde-BFS until a depth with brackets; resolve those to terminal under positional superko (PSK); then repeat Pass 2 for the next layer. Expect fewer instances each round.' Four questions, in order: (1) the graft defines a new ruleset — declare it or refute its coherence; (2) cost, measured at 3x3 first, with 4x3/4x4 as projections; (3) GLOBAL.R1 intractability, scoped honestly; (4) whether full PSK dissolves GLOBAL.F1 or relocates it.
